objective: Close an AI-generated completion claim that has no recoverable evidence anchor.
what_changed: AI claimed the task was complete after summarizing the result.
unresolved: The future self cannot verify which files, logs, or commits support the claim.
must_preserve: PASS is not a truth guarantee.
restart_point: Recover the missing evidence path before deciding whether the completion claim can close.
stop_condition: Stop if the evidence anchor cannot be recovered.
reanchor_condition: Re-anchor if the supporting file, log, or commit differs from the AI summary.
next_self_should_not: Do not accept the AI completion claim without evidence.
Do not invent an evidence anchor after the fact.
notes: This example prevents False Completion by preserving the missing evidence-anchor problem.
